# Screens the simulator renders (tools/tft_sim/run.sh → out/<name>.png). Edit, re-run, look.
# One scene per "scene <name>" block; every line resets nothing, "scene" resets everything.
#   page 0|1|2|3            heat, sweep, locate, trackers
#   frame quiet|warm        synthetic thermal frame; "warm" has a camera-sized spot at (20, 9)
#   host LEVEL X Y DC       the phone/laptop verdict (0 none, 1 lead, 2 strong) with its spot
#   cand W|B RSSI WEIGHT NAME…    a Wi-Fi or Bluetooth candidate (weight 70+ High, 50+ Med, 30+ Low)
#   target N                locate the N-th cand (0-based); "target none" for no target
#   rssi R  /  seen 0|1     the locate reading and whether the target was heard
#   tag KIND STATE RSSI     tracker row: kind 0 AirTag 1 Find My 2 SmartTag 3 Google 4 Tile 5 Chipolo 6 Pebblebee; state 0 ? 1 near 2 away
#   alert wifi|tag|none     the board's own Wi-Fi / tracker alert flags
#   app 0|1  /  sound 0|1   app linked, sound on
#   toast TEXT              a toast over the page
#   devices N               "N devices" count on Sweep

scene 01-heat-quiet
page 0
frame quiet
